purpose: Binding contract for example_meeting; not an import-ready flow or an authenticated Google result

input_sources.calendar_id: Explicit instructor-selected real calendar; primary means the signed-in user's primary calendar
input_sources.idempotency_key: Stable instance/task execution key, unchanged by retry; not request_id alone across separate instances
input_sources.end: Approved start plus meeting_request.duration_min, preserved in approved_option.end
input_sources.time_zone: Explicit real IANA zone whose offsets match start and end
input_sources.room_email: Actual room resource calendar address for approved_option.room, never fictional room_id
input_sources.attendees: All attendee rows for request_id as {email,required}; real authorized test addresses only
input_sources.required_emails: Nonempty attendee.email list filtered by required=true for the same request_id
input_sources.attachments: proposal.docs projected from {title,link} to {title,file_url}; only actual Google Drive/Docs URLs
input_sources.free_busy.calendar_ids: Actual required-attendee calendars plus actual selected room calendars; access must be verified

unresolved_before_import: Original flow only provides request_id/proposal/approved_option. Explicitly supply and review the additional typed context fields listed here; this fragment is not imported automatically.
Original proposal.docs links and slot/room values are fixtures. Read actual tables and Google data; do not promote demo values.
A slot identifies the selected alternative and remains unique. Add end/room_email as needed; retain existing approval-card field names.
OAuth scope grant and actual read calls are required before declaring connectivity. No event is created to discover a return path.
